help.sum:
We aim for all Just Bee Honey orders to be delivered within 5 days of you placing your order.
We offer three different delivery options:
Standard delivery: 3-5 working days
Priority delivery: 2-3 working days
First Class delivery: Next working day (if placed before 3pm, Monday - Friday)
You will receive an email from us confirming when we dispatch your order.
If your order has not arrived after 3 working days from your expected delivery date (as noted above), please contact us at buzz@justbeehoney.co.uk and we will contact the courier and launch an investigation on your behalf.
Delivery charges
There is a small postage charge for each order. This depends on which delivery service you select for your order at the checkout:
Standard delivery: £3.50 or FREE on orders over £40
Priority delivery: £3.99
First Class delivery: £5.99
Does Just Bee Honey deliver outside the UK?
No. Unfortunately we do not deliver our honey outside the UK. Our delivery does cover anywhere in the United Kingdom, including the Highlands and Islands, Scilly Isles and the Isle of Man.

Frequently Asked Questions
From hive to jar, transparency matters to us. Explore our FAQs to learn more about our ingredients, products, orders and everything in between.
Orders
Our Honey
Our Products
Usage and Storage
Bees
Just Bee Rebrand
Why have you changed your branding?
Since the early days of Just Bee, we’ve grown and evolved a lot, and we felt the way our brand looked hadn’t quite kept up with us.
We wanted to make sure our look really represented what we stand for: delicious and simple wellness. We didn’t rush into this, and we made sure to do lots of research - including speaking to you, our amazing community! We've kept all our honey blends and flavours exactly the same, it’s just the labels and website that's changing.
We’re so excited to finally share with you the final result, and we really hope you like it!
We understand many of you loved our old branding, and we have made sure to keep some elements such as the colours, names and of course our bees. Our old look will always be a big part of our story - our new one is just the start of another chapter.

How can we help?
Quickest ways to get help
Browse our FAQs
Find instant answers to questions about orders, delivery, subscriptions, returns and our products. No waiting required.
Go to FAQs ➜
Chat with us
Talk to our team in real time via live chat. Available Monday to Friday, 9am – 5pm, Saturday & Sunday 9am - 1pm. Tap the chat icon in the bottom right corner to start.
Start a chat ➜
Still need help?
Send us an email
If you haven't found your answer, drop us an email and we'll get back to you within 1–2 working days. Please include your order number if your question is about a specific order - we're happy to help!

about.sum:
Our journey began long before wellness became a buzzword, as we believe wellness should be easy, gentle and taste as good as it makes you feel. Instead of chasing the latest fads, we’ve stayed true to nature’s most reliable and delicious ingredients that have quietly supported wellbeing for generations.
My grandad kept bees in Northern Ireland and my dad kept them in Lancashire. As a kid, I got stung so often that I feared them for years. So building a wellness brand around honey is a little ironic.
I came round eventually - developing a real interest in health and wellbeing, and a proper respect for what honey and botanicals can do. What began as a personal project turned into something
I shared with my friend, Andy, and before long we were selling on market stalls around Manchester.
We've been blending in small batches here in the UK ever since, infusing acacia honey with botanicals and vitamins to support things like joints, immunity, sleep, energy and gut health. We now sell over a million pots a year, and core to our success is how good our wellness blends taste.
